update.reason: Track the signed public APT repository; refresh both architectures together and stop for review if the codec ABI changes.

changes.what: Vendor binaries, unchanged, with an immutable, checksum-pinned codec bundle. Plex uses its own musl loader and libraries. Guest confinement belongs to Werewolf's plex form, not a replacement libc or a binary patch.
changes.why: Provide an independently maintained application context with immutable sources and separately updatable Wolfi dependencies.

wolfi.removal_condition: Wolfi provides equivalent packaging, supported versions, architectures and required hardening; review compatibility before retiring this context.
